sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The Custodian gathers what she needs with the brisk energy of someone much younger than she looks. "The Open Vale is where the ward was first forged," she says. "It is where it must be renewed." She looks at each of you in turn. "I cannot do this alone, and what comes for us when the magic rises will not be gentle. But I think you already knew the job was bigger than a crate." When you are ready, the treehouse unfolds one last time, and the road to the Open Vale opens before you.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Commit to the ritual and set out for the Open Vale.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Convert the reveal into commitment, offer real preparation, and bridge to Act 5.

sections.title: GM notes
items: This is the bridge scene. The important output is state, not more lore.
A reluctant yes still counts if the party chooses the hard road with eyes open.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Before we go: you can rest, prepare, ask her what to expect, or spend any favor you earned. It all matters when the ritual starts."
